name: How can I prevent mold growth after water damage in my commercial building?

mainEntity.name: How can I prevent mold growth after water damage in my commercial building?

acceptedAnswer.text: Preventing mold growth primarily involves rapid and thorough drying of all affected areas. Mold thrives in moist conditions, so eliminating moisture within 24-48 hours is critical. This includes removing standing water, drying out structural materials, and reducing humidity levels using professional-grade dehumidifiers and air movers. Additionally, sanitizing affected surfaces helps prevent spores from taking hold. Professional restoration services ensure proper drying and mold prevention.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prevent mold by quickly and thoroughly drying all affected areas, ideally within 24-48 hours, and sanitizing surfaces.
